label: Aquinas I q.19 a.10 co. and ad 2 supports A being that gives x being at w and withholds it at an acc
note: The divine case supplies voluntary alternatives regarding a thing's existence. The typed premise concerns every giver and a particular accessible-world pair, with an indexed exercise of giving in one world and withholding in the other. Applying the source needs the identification of effective willing with the same giver's esse-giving and a correspondence between freedom of choice and the selected accessibility relation.
